data.code:
jump start

.value RED 0
.value WHITE 1
.value BLUE 2
.value COLUMNS 9
.value COLUMNS_2X 18

start:
push RED
push COLUMNS
call draw
push WHITE
push COLUMNS
call draw
push BLUE
push COLUMNS_2X
call draw
push WHITE
push COLUMNS
call draw
push RED
push COLUMNS
call draw
halt

draw:
dup
jump_zero done
pick 1
send 0 1
dec
jump draw

done:
pop
pop
return
